trans-unit.source: Heya, <Suzu>. Why do birds all stick together?
trans-unit.target: Heya, <Suzu>. Why do birds all stick together?

trans-unit.source: It enables them to defend themselves from external threats.
trans-unit.target: It enables them to defend themselves from external threats.

trans-unit.source: So basically, they're weak on their own, but show strength in numbers?
trans-unit.target: So basically, they're weak on their own, but show strength in numbers?

trans-unit.source: Yes. Our teamwork enables us to defeat those who would harm us, such as Dhaos.
trans-unit.target: Yes. Our teamwork enables us to defeat those who would harm us, such as Dhaos.

trans-unit.source: Then let's *all* punch his lights out!
trans-unit.target: Then let's *all* punch his lights out!
